# Derivative Media

> Web design and development studio in Colwyn Bay, North Wales, run by Tom Patel. Tailored websites, bilingual Welsh and English sites, community council websites, local SEO and AI search optimisation for businesses, councils and charities across North Wales.

## Services
- [Websites for North Wales businesses](https://www.derivativemedia.co.uk/websites): what a good small-business site needs, cost drivers, process, choosing a developer
- [Bilingual Welsh and English websites](https://www.derivativemedia.co.uk/websites/bilingual)
- [Community council websites in Wales](https://www.derivativemedia.co.uk/for/community-councils)
- [Local SEO and AI search](https://www.derivativemedia.co.uk/local-seo)
